policy.stablecoins: Top five USD-pegged assets classified by DefiLlama, ranked by CoinGecko market cap
policy.exclusions: Bitcoin, classified stablecoins, known wrapped/staked/bridged duplicates are excluded from the ten alts. Other asset types are included.
policy.poolSample: Up to four mapped pools per discovered contract, among the first twenty returned. Minimum $50,000 liquidity. Only pairs connecting displayed assets. No market-wide flow estimate.
policy.semantics: Gross trader-side swaps in sampled pools. Buy refers to the pool base token. Net is buy dollars minus sell dollars, not new capital. Routes can include arbitrage or multi-hop legs.
